title: Airtight Distribution
content:
Airtight Distribution is a specialist supplier focused on Aspen Aerogels insulation materials and custom conversion services. The company supports pipe insulation, building-envelope, aerospace, and energy-sector projects that require lightweight high-performance aerogel products.

  • Coverage Area: United States and selected international markets
  • Focus Areas: High-temperature insulation, cryogenic service, building-envelope insulation, CAD cutting, and custom aerogel conversion
  • Current Brands Represented: Aspen Aerogels (Pyrogel®, Cryogel®, Spaceloft®)
  • Official Website: https://airtightdistribution.com
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
